name: PayPerScreen
description: Pay-per-call sanctions, crypto-wallet, website, email, and IP risk screening, priced in USDC and authenticated entirely by x402 micropayments. No account, no API key, no subscription.
apiBaseUrlNote: Provisional Railway-assigned hostname. All skill paths below are relative to this base, not to payperscreen.com. See documentationUrl for the live source of truth if this changes.

skills.name: Sanctions name screening
skills.description: Fuzzy name match against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list.

skills.name: Field comparison
skills.description: Field-by-field comparison between a screened subject and the matched sanctions record from a prior /screen hit.

skills.name: Crypto wallet address screening
skills.description: Exact-match lookup against OFAC's sanctioned digital-currency address list.

address.description: Wallet address on any supported chain

skills.name: Website trust check
skills.description: Deterministic composite of domain age, SSL certificate, certificate history, SPF, redirect behavior, security headers, and web-archive history. Returns riskLevel (low/medium/high) and redFlag.

url.description: A URL or bare domain to check

skills.name: Email trust check
skills.description: Deterministic composite of mail-server validity, disposable-domain detection, domain age, mailbox verification, blocklist status, MX provider, and typo-squat detection. Returns riskLevel (low/medium/high) and redFlag.

skills.name: IP risk check (beta)
skills.description: Known-high-risk-IP check against the Spamhaus ZEN blocklist and the Tor exit-node list. IPv4 only. Returns riskLevel (low/medium/high) and redFlag.

ip.description: A public IPv4 address to check
